hidden actions remain forbidden and refresh token is not an access token
disable and role changes invalidate old sessions immediately
ordinary profile edits preserve the active session
empty activity deletion and ownership; concurrent submission is idempotent
rejected corrections; void changes draft totals only until next publication; audited restore
